title: Creative Portfolio Animation Workflow with Framer Motion and React
transcript:
In React and Next.js, Framer Motion (motion/react) is the premier tool for layout animations.
Use the layout and layoutId props for shared element transitions: When a user clicks a project card in the bento grid, the card seamlessly expands into a full-screen modal or detailed view.
Use AnimatePresence for smooth route transitions between the home page and individual project case study pages.
Keep spring animations snappy: use stiffness: 300, damping: 30. Sluggish, slow animations make the website feel laggy.
